Rina (Docs): Quick thread  I'm assembling a compact v1->v2 migration snippet for embeddings. Need: one minimal Go or Python example (copy/pasteable) showing model_id, the exact short error fragment for dim mismatch, and a single-line changelog sentence for the banner. Keep it terse for localization.

Kevin (SDK): I'll paste a minimal Go example (we don't have many Go snippets yet):```go
// Go: prefer model_id, fallback to alias map
package main
import (
  "fmt"
  "github.com/redwood/rdw-go"
)
func main(){
  c := rdw.NewClient("$RDW_KEY")
  alias := map[string]string{"embed-old-512":"embed-new-768"}
  requested := "embed-old-512"
  model_id := requested
  if v, ok := alias[requested]; ok { model_id = v }
  resp, _ := c.Embeddings.Create(rdw.EmbeddingsCreateParams{ModelID: model_id, Input: []string{"hello"}})
  fmt.Println(len(resp.Data[0].Embedding))
}
```

Jo (Runtime): Exact example error (trimmed): `{"error":"embedding failed: vector_dim 512 != expected 768","code":"ERR_DIM_MISMATCH"}`. For docs, match the fragment: "embedding failed: vector_dim". Also note: if you need identical vectors across rollouts, pin the model version.

Rina (Docs): Thanks. Draft troubleshooting sentence for l10n: "If a 400 mentions 'vector_dim', confirm model_id and remap or regenerate vectors; pin model version for deterministic outputs." Priya  that one line ok to localize?

Priya (L10n): Yes, one-line phrases are best. Keep it as-is in the PR description and I will queue translations.

Sam (PM): Changelog line suggestion (single line): "Embeddings: param rename to model_id (aliasing supported); ERR_DIM_MISMATCH on dim mismatch. See migration quickstart." Rina  can we show that as the console banner?

Rina (Docs): Will add the Go example, the error fragment, and both the troubleshooting line and changelog blurb to the migration quickstart PR. Action items: Kevin add small README note to SDK repo with alias example, Jo add the runtime test/assert for ERR_DIM_MISMATCH and paste CI link, Priya queue l10n on merge, Sam to approve changelog copy. Merge when green.

Kevin (SDK): Assigned. I'll add the README example and changelog blurb to PR.

Jo (Runtime): I'll push the test and drop the CI link here when green.
